h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dispur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dispur

items.pText: Dispur is the seat of the Assam government, and many open spaces here belong to government campuses, staff quarters and institutions. Buyers in these offices usually need clear paperwork before anything is ordered. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,080 km away, and we prepare our layout drawings with that approval step in mind. The equipment itself is designed and moulded in-house, so we can answer technical questions directly.

Each drawing shows the equipment we suggest, where it sits on your plot and the safe play area around it. It comes with an itemised quote, so a committee can see exactly what it is approving. Once you sign off, we manufacture at Vasai, send the order to Assam by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in the Northeast.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Choosing equipment for a campus or staff colony

c: In a staff colony, children of every age tend to share one park. A single multi play station with slides, a climbing wall and a deck works for most of them, with a separate swing set placed away from the main walkway. Dispur shares Guwahati's humid climate and heavy monsoon, so plan drainage under the play area and choose rubber flooring over grass, which turns to mud in the rains.

items.q: Can you provide a layout drawing for government approval?
items.a: Yes. We prepare a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, along with an itemised quote. Your committee can review both before any order is placed.

items.q: What warranty do you give on equipment for public campuses?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as instructed.

items.q: Who handles after-sales service in Assam?
items.a: Contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday. We arrange support through our team or a dealer in the region.
